drivingQuestion: What is the meaning of ׳So I will bless You as I live, to Your name I will raise my hands׳?
outcomeNote: An aggadic exposition; nothing is disputed and no dialectical move is made against it.

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: מַאי דִּכְתִיב, ״כֵּן אֲבָרֶכְךָ בְחַיָּי בְּשִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂא כַפָּי״? ״כֵּן אֲבָרֶכְךָ בְחַיָּי״ — זוֹ קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע. ״בְּשִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂא כַפָּי״ — זוֹ תְּפִלָּה. וְאִם עוֹשֶׂה כֵּן — עָלָיו הַכָּתוּב אוֹמֵר: ״כְּמוֹ חֵלֶב וָדֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּע נַפְשִׁי״. וְלֹא עוֹד אֶלָּא שֶׁנּוֹחֵל שְׁנֵי עוֹלָמִים — הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְהָעוֹלָם הַבָּא, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְשִׂפְתֵי רְנָנוֹת יְהַלֶּל פִּי״.
segments.en: The Gemara cites an aggadic statement concerning prayer and the recitation of Shema. «Rabbi Elazar said: What is» the meaning of «that which is written: “So I will bless You as I live, to Your name I will raise my hands”» (Psalms 63:5)? «So I will bless You as I live, refers to the recitation of Shema,» and «to Your name I will raise my hands, refers to» the Amida «prayer,» which is characterized as lifting one’s hands to God. «And if one does so,» recites Shema and prays, «the verse says about him: “As with fat and marrow, my soul will be satisfied”» (Psalms 63:6). «And not only» does he receive this reward, «but he inherits two worlds, this world and the World-to-Come, as it is stated: “With lips of joys [renanot], my mouth praises You”» (Psalms 63:6). The plural, joys, refers to two joys, that of this world and that of the World-to-Come.

moves.summary: The redactor brings an aggadic dictum of R' Elazar from the subject of prayer and Shema discussed earlier

moves.cueHe: מאי דכתיב, ״כן אברכך בחיי בשמך אשא כפי״?
moves.summary: He expounds Psalms 63:5 as Shema and the Amida
moves.about: bringing the verse ׳So I will bless You as I live, to Your name I will raise my hands׳ as the text to be expounded

moves.cueHe: ואם עושה כן — עליו הכתוב אומר
moves.summary: The next verse supplies the reward of one who does both
moves.about: identifying ׳So I will bless You as I live׳ with the recitation of Shema and ׳to Your name I will raise my hands׳ with the Amida prayer

moves.cueHe: ולא עוד אלא שנוחל שני עולמים
moves.summary: The plural ׳joys׳ yields both this world and the World-to-Come
moves.about: adducing the following verse — ׳As with fat and marrow my soul will be satisfied, with lips of joys my mouth praises׳ — as the reward of one who does so
